constraints.value_text: one and one-half times one month’s rent
constraints.evidence_quote:
The maximum-security deposit to be collected by the landlord cannot be more than 
one and one-half times one month’s rent ( N.J.S.A. 46:8-21.2 ).

constraints.obligation_text: Within 30 days of receiving the security deposit, notify the tenant in writing of the bank or investment company's name and address, the deposit amount, type of account, and current interest rate.
constraints.evidence_quote:
Within 30 days of receipt of the security deposit and at t he time of each annual interest payment, the landlord must notify the tenant in writing of the name and address of the banking institution or investment company in which the money is deposited, the amount of the deposit, 
type of account, and current rate o f interest for the account.

constraints.obligation_text: Hold the security deposit in trust, not commingled with the landlord's personal property.
constraints.evidence_quote: The security deposit shall not be comingled with the personal property or become an asset of the landlord.
